correctness.rationale: The addition formula fixes normalization. The full coordinate sign group decomposes exactly into empty, singleton and pair Walsh characters, whose parity halves account for all 2n^2 directions. Sign-averaged entries reduce odd blocks and even empty blocks to explicit 2-by-2 matrices via complete-graph incidence MM^T=(n-2)I+J. The block multiplicities sum to n^2 on the compatible parity half. Degree-five and degree-six exact Gegenbauer substitutions yield determinant, trace and positivity factors establishing n^2 and n^2-1 ranks for n>=5. The standalone checker verifies the exact factors and independently compares 65 full numerical Gram spectra, with max discrepancy 4.546e-14.

value.rationale: The natural type-B spherical point set consists of short and long root shells with different cardinalities and genuine cross-orbit coupling. An all-degree, all-dimension complete sharp evaluation spectrum is a natural sampling invariant, not a single arbitrary parameter computation; the rank decreases from full parity-compatible n^2 at degree five to n^2-1 at degree six in every n>=5, exhibiting a concrete unexpected nonmonotone recovery boundary. The formulas also provide exact optimal singular-value/conditioning data without growing-dimensional eigensolvers.
